discovery.title: A 'library' of bacteria-killing viruses: Harnessing the power of phages
discovery.summary: An estimated 38 trillion bacteria live in the human body—and only a small fraction are harmful to our health. However, the harmful ones can cause serious illness, especially when they develop resistance to antibiotics.
